name: Watchman
about: Stands near the gate in dented mail, spear never far from his hand, and would like to be somewhere else.
greetings: Move along, or do not. It is a public road.
Nothing happens here. That is the job.
If you start something I will have to finish it.
gossip: Something has been taking livestock from the east field.
The elder will talk your ear off. Bring patience.
Do not go into the deep ones alone. People do. People stop.
